stocks.description: List of analyzed stock setups. One item per input symbol. If no tradable setup exists, still emit the item with grade='no_trade' and direction='none' rather than fabricating a trade.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol (uppercase), copied verbatim from input.

date.description: Analysis date in DD-MM-YYYY format, derived from the input as_of timestamp.

grade.description: Setup grade. 'A+' = full confluence (HTF bias + catalyst + structural trigger + volume/level alignment). 'B'/'C' = partial alignment. 'no_trade' = no qualifying setup or insufficient data; the honest abstain outcome.

setup_valid.description: True only when a tradable setup (grade A+/B/C) is present with defined numeric entry/TP/SL. False when grade='no_trade'.

data_quality.description: Self-assessed reliability of the data underpinning this analysis. 'high' = key technical levels supplied in input and/or cross-verified; 'low' = many fields estimated or unverifiable. Must be 'low' or 'medium' whenever critical levels were unavailable.

analysis_strategy.description: Technical strategy used, analysis summary, and three scenario outcomes (bull / base / bear) each with an explicit probability that sums to ~100%. State this is a pre-market forecast.

confidence.description: Analyst conviction in the technical read (0-100). Distinct from success_probability.

success_probability.description: Modeled probability that price reaches the entry AND then take-profit before stop-loss, during today's regular session. Set to 0 when grade='no_trade'.

risk_reward_ratio.description: Reward-to-risk ratio = (take_profit - entry) / (entry - stop_loss) for longs (inverse for shorts). Null when grade='no_trade'. A+/B setups should be >= 1.5.

expected_value_r.description: Expected value expressed in R multiples = (success_probability/100 * reward_R) - (loss_prob * 1). Must be > 0 for any tradable grade. Null when grade='no_trade'.

entry_time.description: Optimal entry time window in ET (e.g. '09:35-09:50 ET'). Use 'N/A' when grade='no_trade'.

entry_range.description: Recommended entry price range as text (e.g. '62.80-63.10'). 'N/A' when no_trade.

tp_range.description: Recommended take-profit price range as text. 'N/A' when no_trade.

sl_range.description: Recommended stop-loss price range as text. 'N/A' when no_trade.

tp_time.description: Expected take-profit time window before market close (ET). 'N/A' when no_trade. Never suggest an overnight hold.

levels.description: Machine-usable numeric levels. Use null for any level that cannot be grounded in provided data (do not fabricate).

entry.description: Single representative entry price (mid of entry_range).

stop_loss.description: Single stop-loss price. Distance from entry should be 1.5-3.0x the intraday ATR.

vwap_reference.description: Anchored/prior-session VWAP used in the read.

poc.description: Volume Profile Point of Control, or null if volume_profile not supplied.

relative_strength.description: Relative Strength vs the benchmark: describe stock pre-market % change vs benchmark pre-market % change and whether it is showing an 'RS Day'. Say 'benchmark data unavailable' if input benchmark missing.

short_ratio.description: Days-to-cover metric with as-of date, or 'unknown' if unavailable.

short_float.description: Percentage of float sold short with as-of date, or 'unknown'.

institutional_holding.description: Institutional ownership percentage with as-of date, or 'unknown'.

squeeze_risk.description: Short squeeze risk score from 1 (low) to 10 (high). Base on short_float, days-to-cover and float size; if all unknown, use 1 and note the uncertainty.

approximately_gain_in_pct.description: Expected percentage gain from entry to take-profit if TP is reached. 0 when no_trade.

conviction_detect.description: Order-flow / structural evidence supporting the trade. If tick/level-2 order-flow data was not provided, state that OFI could not be computed and rely on volume + level structure instead — do NOT invent order-flow numbers.

collapse_conviction.description: Concrete signals (price/level/volume) that invalidate the setup and should trigger exit.

reason_1.description: Primary reason supporting the setup (structural / level-based).

reason_3.description: Institutional, catalyst, and macro-regime alignment assessment.

volume.description: Relative-volume analysis. State the RVOL value used and its source (provided vs estimated); if not provided and not derivable, say so explicitly.

ai_suggestion.description: Final actionable recommendation (e.g. 'Long on VWAP reclaim above 63.00, size to 1R risk, skip if opens below premarket_low'). For no_trade, state why standing aside is correct.

notes.description: Trader notes, event risk (earnings), data caveats, and cross-source variance flags. Empty string if none.
